_comment: ngsolve mhd#7 (SymbolicLFI needs a scalar-valued integrand). Run 2026-08-06 on NGSolve 6.2.2604, unit_square maxh 0.3, VectorH1 order 1. The Lorentz-style source e_y * J * v[1] really is vector-valued at that point -- its .dim is 2 -- and LinearForm.__iadd__ raises NgException with the literal 'SymbolicLFI needs scalar-valued CoefficientFunction', at __iadd__ exactly as the claim says. Both working spellings are then checked: indexing the test function (J*v[1]) and InnerProduct(e_y*J, v) assemble to vectors that agree entry for entry to 0.0 and are not the zero vector, so the fix is not unique and either is correct. Mutation: replacing e_y by the scalar 1.0 removes the exception and the fixture fails on vector_integrand_raised.
